variables.name: LINKDING_POSTGRES_SERVER
variables.description: Server where the linkding PostgreSQL database is located.

variables.name: LINKDING_POSTGRES_USER
variables.description: User used to connect to the linkding PostgreSQL database.

variables.name: LINKDING_POSTGRES_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password used to connect to the linkding PostgreSQL database.

variables.name: LINKDING_POSTGRES_DATABASE
variables.description: Name of the linkding PostgreSQL database.

variables.name: LINKDING_INITIAL_USER
variables.description: Username of the initial linkding superuser.

variables.name: LINKDING_INITIAL_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password of the initial linkding superuser.

variables.name: LINKDING_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Django secret key for linkding (kept stable across restarts since the data dir is ephemeral).

variables.name: LINKDING_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Client ID for linkding to authenticate against the OIDC provider.

variables.name: LINKDING_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Client secret for linkding to authenticate against the OIDC provider.
